description: This file appears to be a shell script that contains test cases for integration and functionality checks of a Perforce and Git setup, specifically testing handling of filenames and branch names with shell metacharacters. It includes commands to initialize depot, create and remove files with special characters, and manage branches with special characters in their names.

methods.name: start_p4d
methods.description: Starts the Perforce server daemon needed for testing.

methods.name: cleanup_git
methods.description: Cleans up the git repository after tests.

methods.name: test_create_repo
methods.description: Creates a new git repository for testing purposes.
